description:
Columbus AFB has a requirement for the lease/rent of an ARFF firefighting vehicle.  The Government shall not exercise any supervision or control over the contract service providers performing the requirement herein.  Such contract service providers shall be accountable solely to the Contractor who, in turn is responsible to the Government. Unless otherwise identified herein, the contractor shall provide all management, labor, equipment, transportation, tools, materials and  other items necessary to lease/rent an ARFF firefighting vehicle as defined in the Statement of Need. 

 Solicitation number  FA302227Q0300  is issued as a    request for quotation (RFQ).  

  

 2. SUBMISSION OF QUESTIONS 

 
	 Deadline:  01 December 2026 at 10:00 AM CDT  
	 Method:  All questions must be submitted in writing via email to the primary and alternate Points of Contact (POCs) listed below.  
	 Subject Line Requirement:  You must include the solicitation number in your email subject line: FA302227Q0300 - Questions - [Your Company Name]  
 

  The Government is not obligated to answer any questions submitted after the deadline.  

  

 3. SUBMISSION OF QUOTES 

 
	 Deadline:  07 December 2026 at 10:00 AM CDT  
	 Method:  A completed Quote and Technical Narrative IAW SOW must be submitted via email to both POCs listed below . 
	 Subject Line Requirement:  Include the solicitation number in the subject line: FA302227Q0300   - Quote Submission - [Your Company Name].  
	 Verification:  Ensure you request and receive a "Received" confirmation email to verify your submission was delivered successfully.  
	 Formatting Note:  Do not copy and paste the Statement of Work (SOW) into your Technical Narrative.  
 

  The Government is not obligated to accept any quotes or narratives submitted after the deadline.  

 4. SYSTEM FOR AWARD MANAGEMENT (SAM) REGISTRATION 

 All contractors who provide goods or services to the Department of Defense (DoD) must have an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) prior to award. Additionally, offerors must ensure that  NAICS Code 532490  is active on their SAM profile. Failure to comply with SAM registration requirements will deem the offeror ineligible for award. 

 Responses must contain sufficient detail for the Government to assess the source’s technical capability and transition approach. Submit responses through the contact method identified in the SAM.gov notice no later than the stated response deadline.
